summary: This applicability statement covers when IPv6 UDP datagrams may use a zero checksum. It gives recommendations and requirements, describes the issues and design principles for UDP tunnels over IPv6, and examines the role of the IPv6 UDP checksum. It also notes constraints on network paths that include middleboxes.

eli5.summary: Skipping a safety check is only okay in some cases. This lays out when it is fine and what can go wrong, especially with in-between network gear.
